title: Metatheos Golden Roadmap (Test)
description: Golden test roadmap with canonical schema. If this loads, the pipeline is correct.

phases.title: Phase 0: Foundation & Visibility
phases.content:
Intent: Establish canonical entities, storage, and UI visibility.

Definition of Done:
- Schema stable
- Ingest works
- UI renders phases and goals
- No silent crashes

This is a test phase to validate the roadmap pipeline.

goals.title: Roadmap ingestion baseline
goals.content:
Ingest reads roadmap JSON and persists phases/goals without crashing.

Acceptance: Roadmap loads in UI, all phases visible, no console errors.

tasks.title: Parse roadmap file
tasks.content: Reads JSON, validates schema_version, loads phases.

tasks.title: Normalize malformed data
tasks.content: Auto-fix common issues: missing fields, wrong types, enum objects.

goals.title: UI rendering stability
goals.content:
UI can render all roadmap entities without crashes.

Acceptance: No undefined errors, no .map() failures, graceful degradation.

phases.title: Phase 1: Canon & Constraints
phases.content:
Intent: Make definitions explicit and immutable.

This phase tests date handling and status transitions.

goals.title: Canonical chart of accounts
goals.content: Define chart of accounts with explicit types and normal balances.
